This indicates a possible pathway where Simvastatin may influence lipid metabolism through its interaction with Pravastatin, potentially contributing to the management of hypertriglyceridemia. The scores from the two paths, while not identical, both reflect a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that the evidence supports a plausible mechanistic link.
